name: claude-specs
description: Shared Claude Code foundations pulled into other repos: orchestrator agents, universal principles, and a secret-scan hook.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Orchestrator foundations: generic builder/explorer/planner/reviewer agents, a new-project command, a secret-scan hook, and universal working principles.

plugins.name: spec-agentic
plugins.description: Specification doctrine and toolkit for work executed by coding agents: declared-executor headers, a LOCKED/WORKING/OPEN facts ledger, stable anchor IDs with CI verifiers, an OpenAPI contract set, impact maps, and a read-only spec auditor. Pairs with spec-human.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: Slim remnant of affaan-m/ECC (MIT): 6 curated skills — seo, design-system, api-design, accessibility, make-interfaces-feel-better, postgres-patterns. The other ~580 vendored items were removed 2026-08-25 after a usage audit (re-vendor from upstream if ever needed).

plugins.name: ruby
plugins.description: Curated Ruby/Rails/Hotwire/TDD skills (17), vendored (MIT) from superpowers-ruby + rails-agent-skills + ruby-core-skills, slimmed 2026-08-25. Opt-in; install for Ruby on Rails work.

plugins.name: review-council
plugins.description: Always-on multi-persona code-review pipeline: parallel distinct-angle reviewer panels → a Code Review Master → a second adversarial panel → Master 2 → an opt-in Executor & Fixer. No token optimization; every panelist is always spun up. Opt-in.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Document production: latex-doc renders Markdown deliverables into overflow-safe thesis-style PDFs (pandoc + XeLaTeX, three-families overflow method), and pt-pt enforces European Portuguese in every Portuguese response (vendored from mfrade/claude-skills).

plugins.name: consulting
plugins.description: Consulting-grade analysis-framework design: chapter skeleton, named frameworks, per-chapter data requirements, and a visualisation plan from just a research subject; data gathered via ordinary research, report written against the framework with a zero-hallucination policy. Opt-in.
